_about: Public-domain Henry Hart Milman (1791-1868), Dean of St Paul's, for the Word Hoard: his church histories, The History of Christianity to the Abolition of Paganism (1840, three volumes), the History of Latin Christianity in its first edition (1854-55, six volumes) and The History of the Jews (third edition, 1863, three volumes), from Internet Archive scans. His Greek-play translations sit on lane B's shelves and are not repeated here. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 35 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
